top_signals.title: Autonomous Muslim Region in Philippines Holds First Election to Cement Peace
top_signals.summary: Voters in a predominantly Muslim autonomous region of the Philippines began casting ballots in the area’s first-ever parliamentary election, more than a decade after a peace deal with separatists ended four decades of conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Refereeing body says decision to award decisive goal in Manchester derby was wrong
top_signals.summary: Haaland's strike on the hour mark was initially disallowed for offside but was allowed to stand after a VAR review found him to be onside.

top_signals.title: U.S. Dams Could Unlock 15.2 Terawatt-Hours of Untapped Hydropower
top_signals.summary: The United States’ existing dams could produce an additional 15.2 terawatt-hours of electricity per year, enough to power more than  1.4 million homes across the country. A new study from Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Idaho National Laboratory found that by retrofitting select dams that are not already outfitted for hydropower production could prove to be a critical and efficient source of clean energy at a much lower cost than traditional hydropower projects. These findings are based on modelling through a new software called HydroGenerate,…

top_signals.title: Revolut attackers threaten daily customer data leaks
top_signals.summary: Attackers reportedly published identity documents and selfies belonging to Revolut customers and threatened to release more data each day until the fintech pays.
